pages.title: Void Lattice Ore
pages.text: Bulk stone holding pockets of a crystal made of nothing - a lattice of empty sites that remains rigid even though there is nothing in them. It looks like a gap in the rock that has decided to be solid.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Mining in the Bulk, I hit a patch of rock that the pick went through as though it were air but that still dropped something. The lattice was a crystal of vacancies, ordered without anything to order.
$(thing)Found$(): in veins through the Bulk (mine it for its drop).
